description.en: Original generic geological-form analog of isolated residual rock hill. Government definition and official park photographs inform form, not geological period, named-site DEM, precise dimensions, cultural detail or coexisting ecosystem. Nominal module1100x900x180m with rock roughly500x350x170m, illustrative not measured. No universally igneous origin asserted; public broad Uluru silhouette and Bald Rock granite flank are separate examples, not conflated lithology or site reconstruction.
